meta.name: strategic-alliances
meta.description: Structures partnerships that change what the business can do — technology integrations, channel and reseller arrangements, joint ventures, and OEM relationships. Use this to evaluate or structure a strategic partnership, decide between partnering and building, negotiate commercial terms of an alliance, or diagnose a partnership that is signed but not producing. For audience-borrowing partnerships, use `marketing:partnership-marketing`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估、构建并落地能让企业能力升级的战略合作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正考虑用技术、渠道或合资伙伴扩展业务,却不确定如何评估和谈判。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate and land strategic partnerships that expand what your business can do

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你评估和构建战略合作伙伴关系：判断该合作、自建还是购买，设计排他性、收入分成、客户归属等条款，并诊断签约后没产出的合作哪里出了问题。
howto.when: 当你提到“战略合作”、“伙伴关系”等词，或要求评估合作方案、谈判条款、诊断停滞的合作时触发；若只是借用对方受众，会转用营销技能。

say.text: 帮我评估下和这家公司的战略合作，该合作还是自己开发？
say.note: 按合作/自建/购买框架给出建议。

say.text: 这份合作协议的排他性和分成条款怎么谈更稳妥？
say.note: 逐条检查关键条款风险。

say.text: 这个合作签了半年没产出，帮我诊断卡在哪。
say.note: 定位责任方和激励是否错位。

howto.what_en: Helps evaluate and structure business-changing partnerships: decide build vs. partner, design commercial terms (exclusivity, revenue, ownership), and diagnose stalled signed deals.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to evaluate, negotiate, or diagnose a strategic partnership; audience-borrowing deals route to marketing.

say_en.text: Help me evaluate this strategic partnership—should we partner or build in-house?
How should we handle exclusivity and revenue split in this alliance agreement?
This partnership signed six months ago but hasn't produced. Diagnose it.
